PAIA · Editorial draft for publication review
Imagine sending an AI a job description
and asking whether the role is a good fit.
The words are in your message. The
suddenly your ambitions. A system that
preserves the message has recorded a
fact. A system that turns every line into
your preference has made a different,
someone else. Even a sentence you
wrote entirely yourself may be a
hypothesis, not a conclusion. Its meaning
depends on the question you were
This is why PAIA treats an original
expression and an interpretation of that
source can tell you what was sent. A
topic can help bring related material
may make it easier to read. None of these
should silently become a new personal
uncertainty. It should allow you to inspect
something without having to fight a
confident story about yourself. A note
that says “I am considering this” should
Context for a new task needs relevance,
but it also needs the right role for each
quotation. An earlier plan can be
identified as an earlier plan. A current
preference can be selected because you
The aim is not to make your archive timid.
It is to make it trustworthy enough to
work with: useful structure, visible origins
and the last word left with you.
A product perspective, not a claim of released capability.
Your thinking has a longer tomorrow.
